blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), with assistance from four fishermen, rescued four persons who were swept away by a strong waves while swimming off Barangay San Francisco, San Fernando City, La Union, on Friday. In a statement, the PCG said its Coast Guard Station La Union Baywatch Team responded to the incident and successfully brought the four individuals to safety. The four local fishermen assisted the Coast Guard personnel in the rescue operation. The incident occurred as tourists flocked to the province’s beaches during the long Undas holiday.
